what: Adding a part to a dependency image changes `write_image`'s argument from `[&[u8]; 2]` to `[&[u8]; 3]`, so every caller (serve.rs, deps/tests.rs, deps/signatures/tests.rs) must change in the same batch; one of them is a file outside the lane's list, so the lane cannot leave a compiling test tree alone. `Part::DefMap` also held tag 2, the next free part tag, and parts are indexed by `part as usize`, so a part numbered after it would have indexed past the array.
cost: a hand-off to the main agent for a one-line edit, and a read of every `Part` use to find the tag/index coupling
cause: an image's parts are a positional array whose length is the number of kinds, and a non-part (`DefMap`, a refusal's name) shares the tag space
class: a persisted container whose shape is spelled at each writer by position
prevention: write an image from a value with one named field a part (or a builder keyed by `Part`), and take `DefMap` out of `Part` into the refusal's own type
workaround: renumbered DefMap to 3 with a const assertion that each part's tag is its place in Part::ALL; listed signatures/tests.rs:603 for the main agent
